name: scots_wikipedia
origin: Scots Wikipedia: ~49% of the entries (20,000+) were written by one US editor who did not speak Scots, by grafting words from an online dictionary onto English sentences
notes: Not ground truth for Scots. Its worth is as a NEGATIVE control: does a model prefer fake Scots (English grammar + Scots words) over real Scots? Real-Scots sources still to be found and checked.
